landing.title: Bridge
landing.subtitle: Complete Traceability of Strategic Minerals
landing.description: TrackMine is a complete and immutable traceability platform for strategic minerals (cobalt, copper, etc.) from extraction to sale or export.

hero.title: Complete traceability of strategic minerals
hero.subtitle: Track every batch of cobalt, copper and critical minerals, from mining to transport, with total and verifiable transparency.
hero.description: TrackMine is an independent traceability platform that centralizes official documents, institutional validations and mining batch history, without ever replacing competent authorities.

features.title: Uncompromising traceability
features.subtitle: From extraction to export, every step is documented, validated and auditable.

blockchain.title: Immutable blockchain
blockchain.description: Every document and validation is anchored via a cryptographic fingerprint ensuring integrity, timestamping and impossibility of falsification throughout the value chain.

compliance.title: Regulatory compliance
compliance.description: Centralize documents issued by competent authorities (SAEMAPE, Mining Division, cooperatives) and facilitate audits through clear and structured traceability.

traceability.title: Complete traceability
traceability.description: Visualize in real-time the history of a batch: mining, purchase, transport, associated documents, validations and overall status.

featuresWorkflow.title: A system designed for field realities
featuresWorkflow.description: TrackMine adapts to local operational constraints: low connectivity, multiple stakeholders, documents issued by different authorities, and need for control without complexity.

fast.title: Fast
fast.description: Designed to work in the field with simple flows, quick actions and optimized data entry.

powerful.title: Powerful
powerful.description: Manage thousands of batches, documents and validations without performance loss.

secure.title: Secure
secure.description: Fine-grained access control, complete historization and tamper-proof evidence.

ai.title: AI-Assisted
ai.description: Data consistency support, anomaly detection and business control automation.

cta.title: Switch to reliable and auditable traceability
cta.description: Strengthen trust, simplify audits and secure your mining flows with modern, transparent and compliant traceability.

stakeholders.title: Designed for all actors in the mining chain

governance.title: A neutral and independent platform
governance.description: TrackMine does not issue any official documents and does not replace any authority. The platform acts as a trusted registry, ensuring traceability, integrity and transparency of information provided by competent authorities.
